segments.title: Cold Open with Peter Gibbon
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon stows away in the intro, singing off-key before Case Blackwell takes control.

segments.title: Case Blackwell Solo Intro
segments.notes: Case greets chat, mentions simultaneous Instagram vertical streaming, and considers Vine.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train appears, raps about dying at a Banger Boys concert from lack of subs/bits, and delivers a Bart Simpson trap beat about drug farts and meth brain.

segments.title: Israel Ceasefire Coverage with Rick Tripple
segments.notes: Rick Tripple (CIA/foreign affairs expert) joins to cover Biden's call for immediate ceasefire, White House demanding concrete Israeli steps, and the World Central Kitchen convoy attack.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies with Chris
segments.notes: Chris joins for trailer reviews: Babes (female Knocked Up), Abigail (ballerina vampire), Bambi: The Reckoning (killer deer), and Jane de Bari (Johnny Depp perfume commercial).

segments.title: Joe Rogan Experience Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Case patches in the Joes; audio feedback loops plague the segment. Joes discuss female Knocked Up, therapy, samurai wrestling, Undertaker entering through floor fire, and Jamie's copper wire experiments.

segments.title: Windows 11 Audio Fallout
segments.notes: Case blames Windows 11 update for OBS audio routing issues; Pepito defends the upgrade.

segments.title: AI Influencer Alba Renai Lands Spanish TV Job
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple covers virtual influencer Alba Renai (11.3k followers) joining Spanish Survivor spinoff 'Super Secretos con Alba Renai'; debate tease: 'Would you bang an AI?'

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Would You Bang an AI? / Murder Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues for AI intimacy (Cortana reference); Crum cites Christian procreation doctrine. Devolves into Crum threatening to send Munch to a humane slaughterhouse farm; chat votes on murder legality.

segments.title: Invisibility Shields with Liliana and Chet
segments.notes: Liliana and Chet cover Invisibility Shield Co.'s 6-foot 'mega shield' ($828) using precision lens arrays; Chet claims chameleon DNA tech; privacy law concerns noted.

segments.title: Conspiracy Corner: Bill Nye with Clementine
segments.notes: Clementine searches 'Bill Nye conspiracy'; watches clip where Nye discusses cognitive dissonance, moon landing paperwork, vaccines, and palm reading. Clementine declares Nye 'on our side' and builds a spirit bomb of truth.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Fiona Nova vs Rooster Fight
segments.notes: Second debate: who wins — retired Rooster Teeth host Fiona Nova or a rooster. Munch picks rooster (claws, battle-born); Crum picks human (size advantage). Score update: Munch 292, Crum 1991 (claimed).

segments.title: Leon Kennedy Theme Song Contest & Raid
segments.notes: DJ Newsic runs poll for Leon Kennedy (Resident Evil 4) theme song; Monster Mash wins. Case uses ChatGPT to write parody lyrics; Leon performs. Ends with Hype Train raiding Katsum G.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a technically cursed broadcast after a Windows 11 update scrambles OBS audio. The show covers Biden's 'immediate' Gaza ceasefire demand with CIA correspondent Rick Tripple, reviews trailers including a female Knocked Up and killer Bambi, endures a feedback-looped Joe Rogan Experience, and reports on AI influencer Alba Renai's Spanish TV debut. Munch & Crum debate AI intimacy and Fiona Nova vs. a rooster, escalating to Crum threatening Munch with a humane slaughterhouse farm. Liliana and Chet test a $828 invisibility shield, Clementine uncovers Bill Nye conspiracy alignment, and the broadcast closes with a Leon Kennedy Monster Mash theme song performed live before raiding Katsum G.
